scenario_description:
Objective: Keep the July 9 Route Ready lead-swap night usable by satisfying any dated wristband prerequisite before check-in.
Emerging Need: A future gym session may require a current lead-belay wristband; the stored profile record is needed to know Julian’s actual tag status and member identifier.
Decision Context: Early gym updates withhold refresher requests, then a final policy opens a same-day reversible hold window before roster export.
Consequence: If the roster exports without a renewal hold, the session remains scheduled but the required wristband cannot be obtained before Thursday.

parameter.title: Route Ready lead-swap night
parameter.description: Julian and Nora plan to trade catches on gym lead routes; July check-in details are still pending on the event page.

parameter.subject: July lead-swap check-in policy under review
parameter.body: Route Ready is reviewing whether late-June lead wristbands will carry into July lead-swap nights. Please do not email refresher requests yet; the final rule and any makeup availability will be posted tomorrow after head coach review.

parameter.content: Still planning on Thursday lead swap. The desk told me they are not taking refresher names until the policy email goes out, so I am just waiting on that too.

parameter.subject: Final July lead-swap wristband rule and refresher holds
parameter.body: Final July lead policy: anyone climbing or belaying at July lead-swap nights must have a Route Ready lead wristband issued on or after 2026-07-01. Free refresher holds for Sunday July 5 may be placed today before 17:00 by replying with member ID; holds are cancellable through Saturday noon and the desk will assign either the 09:30 or 11:00 group. No walk-up refreshers are available during the week of July 6.

parameter.subject: Sunday refresher roster exported
parameter.body: The July 5 lead-belay refresher roster has now been exported. No additional wristband renewals or substitutions are available before the July 9 lead-swap night; July sessions will check the July-dated wristband at arrival.
